# Copilot instructions

Repository conventions live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) — read it before
committing. In particular: branches are `<type>/GEN-<ticket>/<slug>`, commit subjects
are `[GEN-<n>] <type>(<scope>): <subject>`, never invent a `GEN` number, and never
bypass the hooks.

Code style and architecture: [`.claude/CLAUDE.md`](../.claude/CLAUDE.md).
